mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (high capacity utilization), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruption that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% quarterly, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it triggers monetary policy tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that precedes economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a declining unemployment rate signals labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% and declines, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
